title.zh: 规定政府聘用从事需要医学知识职位的医师最低年薪为2400比索的法案
title.en: An Act Fixing the Minimum Compensation of Physicians Employed By the Government in Positions Requiring Medical Knowledge to Two Thousand Four Hundred Pesos Per Annum
title.orig: An Act Fixing the Minimum Compensation of Physicians Employed By the Government in Positions Requiring Medical Knowledge to Two Thousand Four Hundred Pesos Per Annum

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 3 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1951/ra_664_1951.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: Any provision of law to the contrary notwithstanding, all physicians employed on full time basis by the Government in positions requiring the knowledge of medicine, shall receive a minimum annual compensation of two thousand four hundred pesos.

The President of the Philippines is hereby authorized to use such sums as may be necessary to carry out the purpose of this Act, but not to exceed one hundred thousand pesos, to be taken from any funds in the Philippine Treasury not otherwise appropriated.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved, June 16, 1951.
